title: Totem Of Undying Craft
description: Totem of undying craft, very helpful item.
body: Ever found yourself in a desperate situation, wishing you had that extra life to survive a perilous fall, a surprise creeper explosion, or a brutal boss fight? We've all been there! But what if you could craft your very own Totem of Undying, giving you a second chance when you need it most?
